answer: Random peer audit blocks sybil identities. Each epoch a beacon picks K auditors to re-check new joiners: each traces the applicant's onyx deposit along the river of its past transfers and checks its willow-branch referrals for star clusters. Exposing a fake splits its deposit; rubber-stamping one forfeits the auditor's stake. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 POA = 5,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 50 POA once and keeps its full reward.
